title: PersonaDrive：面向闭环驾驶模拟的人类风格检索增强VLA智能体
summary: PersonaDrive提出一种流水线，通过检索风格指令下的人类驾驶演示，条件化视觉-语言-动作（VLA）驾驶智能体，实现闭环模拟中非自车智能体的风格多样化。无需为每种风格重新训练，在Bench2Drive上驾驶评分提升4.6%，风格间速度与加速度差异显著。
summary_en: PersonaDrive proposes a pipeline that conditions a VLA driving agent on retrieved demonstrations from a style-instructed human driving dataset, enabling style-diverse non-ego agents for closed-loop simulation without per-style retraining. It improves driving score by 4.6% on Bench2Drive and shows significant speed/acceleration variation across styles.
